questions.question: Calculate 1,375 × 6 and explain how you placed the decimal comma.
questions.expected_answer: 1 375 × 6 = 8 250. 1,375 has three decimal places, so the answer has three: 8,250 = 8,25. Estimate: a bit less than 6 × 1,5 = 9.

questions.question: Calculate 12,45 × 2,5 and give the cost in rand to the nearest cent.
questions.expected_answer: 1 245 × 25 = 31 125; 2 + 1 = 3 decimal places gives 31,125, so R31,13. Estimate: 12 × 2,5 = 30.

questions.question: Explain why 0,3 × 0,2 = 0,06 and why 2,5 × 1,4 is not 0,35.
questions.expected_answer: Tenths times tenths gives hundredths: 3/10 × 2/10 = 6/100 = 0,06. 25 × 14 = 350 and two decimal places gives 3,50 = 3,5; the estimate of about 3 rules out 0,35.
